fightLines.line: You wake up with dirt in your mouth and blood on your hands that isn't yours. The sky is the wrong color — not sunset-wrong, wound-wrong. Rebecca Cao. Wild food forager. From Columbus, Ohio. That was yesterday. This is now. You have: Knife roll, Trail compass, Mother's Ring, Seed packet, Brass Locket. That's everything you own in this world. Haven. Twelve people. The fire is lit. You heard it in the dark. Breathing. Not yours. It knew your name — it said it wrong, like it learned the shape of the sound but not what it meant.
You remember the Crossbow at your space in the haven and fetch it — it rides in your pack now.

◈ FLASHBACK — Seed packet
Pressed into your hand with an order: keep people fed through winter. Seeds are a plan. Plans are how you stop being helpless.

◈ FLASHBACK — Trail compass
Lost above the fog line, visibility down to your boots. You didn't panic — just held the compass flat, found north, and walked out like it was nothing. It was not nothing.

◈ RESONANCE HARMONICS — SYSTEM: "HYPOTHESIS CONFIRMED. Objects with high observer-attention waveforms function as auxiliary capacitors. We call this RESONANCE HARMONICS. We do not know why the waveforms taste like grief. We have stopped asking." — Hold a keepsake. Think about them. The System will do the math. (It is not math. It is love. The System will never know.)
